wiki.title: How 24GO Works
wiki.subtitle: Complete platform guide — from registration to first leads
wiki.section.overview.title: Platform Overview
wiki.section.overview.forWhat: 24GO is a platform for automating customer discovery in Telegram and VK. It helps real estate agents, travel agencies, and any business find potential buyers without manual searching. Without automation, you spend hours monitoring chats and lose hot customers.
wiki.section.overview.architecture: The architecture is simple: Accounts → Monitoring → Leads → Sales. Each step is automated.
wiki.section.overview.howTo:
Sign up and choose a plan
Add 1-2 Telegram accounts to start
Find target groups via search
Start monitoring — AI begins analysis
Receive and process leads
wiki.section.overview.expect:
First leads appear within 24-48 hours after setup
Results depend on activity in selected groups
More accounts = wider reach
wiki.section.overview.tip: Start with the free trial (3 days) to make sure the platform fits your business.
wiki.section.accounts.title: Accounts
wiki.section.accounts.forWhat: Accounts are working Telegram profiles through which the system monitors and sends messages. Without accounts, the platform cannot work with Telegram. Each account works independently, like a separate employee.
wiki.section.accounts.howTo:
Click "Add Account" in the Accounts section
Enter Telegram phone number (+7...)
Receive verification code in Telegram
Enter the code in the system
Wait for warmup (3-7 days, 5-15 messages/day)
wiki.section.accounts.expect:
1 account = 5-20 messages/day after warmup (depends on account)
Recommendation: 100 accounts for 1000 mailings/day (gradually increase to 2000)
"Warmup" status is normal — Telegram limits new accounts
"Banned" status means you need a new account
wiki.section.accounts.accountTypes:
Which accounts to use:
• Accounts aged 3+ months — lowest ban risk
• Accounts with profile photo, bio, and history — look human
• Avoid brand new accounts — high ban risk even after warmup
• Buy aged accounts from trusted sellers only — check reviews
• Each account needs its own proxy — sharing IPs = guaranteed ban
wiki.section.accounts.tip: Add accounts in advance. Warmup takes 3-7 days, and until it's complete, mailing volume is limited.
wiki.section.accounts.warning: Don't use one account for too many mailings — it will lead to blocking. Follow the recommended limits.
wiki.section.search.title: Group Search
wiki.section.search.forWhat: Find target Telegram groups where your potential customers communicate. Without this, monitoring will be useless — you need to know where to look.
wiki.section.search.howTo:
Enter a keyword (e.g., "Moscow real estate")
Select country and category (for TgStat)
Click "Find"
Review results and add interesting groups to monitoring
wiki.section.search.expect:
Free search available on all plans
TgStat (Pro/Enterprise): 1₽/query (Pro), 0.50₽/query (Enterprise)
Semantic expansion: AI generates 10-15 query combinations
Results cached for 24 hours
wiki.section.search.tip: Use specific keywords. "Moscow real estate" gives better results than just "real estate".
wiki.section.monitoring.title: Monitoring
wiki.section.monitoring.forWhat: Track messages in groups and automatically find potential customers among them. AI analyzes every message and classifies it: hot lead, warm, cold, or spam.
wiki.section.monitoring.howTo:
Find groups via "Group Search"
Add them to monitoring
Assign an account to each group
System starts analysis automatically — 24/7
wiki.section.monitoring.expect:
1 account = up to 30 groups
Leads arrive in real time
Classification: HOT/WARM/COLD/SPAM
Limits: 10 (Trial), 100 (Starter), 500 (Pro), ∞ (Enterprise)
wiki.section.monitoring.tip: Assign different accounts to different groups. This reduces blocking risk and improves efficiency.
wiki.section.mailings.title: Mailings
wiki.section.mailings.forWhat: Mass sending of personalized messages to potential customers. Allows you to quickly reach a large number of people with individual offers.
wiki.section.mailings.howTo:
Click "New Mailing"
Enter name and message text
Use variables {first_name}, {username} for personalization
Import recipient list (1 @username per line)
Click "Create", then "Start"
wiki.section.mailings.expect:
25 accounts × 40 messages = 1000/day
5000 mailings in 5 days
Conversion: 30-80 replies → 10-30 leads
Delay 5-30 sec between messages (spam protection)
wiki.section.mailings.warning: Follow the limits: 50 (Starter), 500 (Pro), 5000 (Enterprise) per day. Exceeding will lead to account blocking.
wiki.section.leads.title: Leads
wiki.section.leads.forWhat: Manage potential customers: view, reply, change status. All contacts found by the system are collected in one place for convenient processing.
wiki.section.leads.howTo:
Open the "Leads" section
Review the lead card
Click "Open Dialog" to reply
Change status: New → In Progress → Converted
wiki.section.leads.expect:
HOT — respond urgently, high deal chance
WARM — persuade, show value
COLD — don't waste time, return later
SPAM — automatically filtered out
wiki.section.leads.tip: Focus on HOT leads — they give maximum conversion. Don't waste time on COLD until hot ones are handled.
wiki.section.rules.title: Lead Rules
wiki.section.rules.forWhat: Automatic classification of messages by keywords. Allows you to finely configure which messages are considered hot leads and which are spam.
wiki.section.rules.howTo:
Click "Create Rule"
Enter a name (e.g., "Buyers")
Add keywords separated by commas ("buy, price, cost")
Select classification (HOT/WARM/COLD/SPAM)
Set priority (higher = checked earlier)
wiki.section.rules.expect:
Rule accuracy: 70-85%
Combination of rules + AI = maximum accuracy
Rules checked by priority, then AI heuristic is used
wiki.section.rules.tip: Start with simple rules for HOT and SPAM. Add finer settings over time as data accumulates.
wiki.section.campaigns.title: Campaigns
wiki.section.campaigns.forWhat: Publishing posts in Telegram groups on schedule. Automatically places content with text, photos, videos, and emojis in selected groups.
